research_question: When do repeated YouTube content observations justify describing a category as declining rather than differently sampled?

registered_example_checks.finding: Reported NFL-related view and upload growth between 2020 and 2025
registered_example_checks.reason: Two positive-growth endpoint comparisons, no intermediate monthly series and no declining period evidence.

registered_example_checks.finding: One global annual 2024 view lower bound for a specific title query
registered_example_checks.reason: No same-title predicate observations for other full years.

registered_example_checks.finding: One partial 2025 global view lower bound for a different title query
registered_example_checks.reason: Does not share topic predicate or period with the prom study.
Raw before/after public counts have noncomparable measurement definitions without explicit reconciliation.

single_comparison_requirements: Same topic classification or frozen video title predicate
Same observed population, country and language inclusion
Same video format and public view versus engaged view definition
Same observation unit and complete equal-duration period
Same API method, query sampling frame and comparable missingness
Same pre/post August 24 2026 view epoch or source-verified reconciliation
Exact bounded numeric counts; two lower bounds cannot be subtracted or interpreted as a precisely measured change

trend_inference_gates.reason: No registered candidate has comparable multi-year sequential observations sufficient for a decline trajectory.
A one-off event or partial year cannot distinguish recurrence and secular decline.
Platform supply, algorithm shifts and dated format changes remain unadjusted.
The August 2026 public playback-start revision is not fully reconciled across historical candidate series.
No audited sample variance, within-topic inclusion and creator profit distribution.

output_discipline.two_compatible_exact_points: Can describe a change between two observed periods; never label it a persistent trend or causal drop.
output_discipline.repeated_decline: Requires repeated comparable period bins, stable sampling, uncertainty, seasonality controls and appropriately bounded claim.
output_discipline.creator_competition: Declining view events do not directly establish reduced active viewers, fewer creators or profit.
